31:3: Adonoy, your God, His word is crossing before you, He will destroy these nations before you and you will inherit them.
Yehoshua, he is crossing before you
31:5: and you will do to them
in accord with the mitzvah that I commanded you.
31:8: And Adonoy is the One Who is going ahead of you, His word will be your support,
will not abandon you and will not distance you;
do not fear and do not quake.
31:11: When all of Yisroel comes to be seen in the presence of Adonoy, your God,
in the place that He chooses,
you shall read this Torah before all of Yisroel for them to hear.
31:12: Assemble the people — the men and the women and the infants,
and your convert who is in your towns;
in order for them to hear and in order for them to learn to fear before Adonoy, your God,
and they will make sure to fulfill
all the statements of this Torah.
31:16: and this people will arise and stray after the idols of the nations of the land that they are going there among them,
and they will forsake the fear of Me and break My covenant
31:17: And I will wax angry at them on that day and I will distance them and I shall remove My Shechina from them and they will be scorned
and many evils and troubles will happen to them;
and they will say on that day,
‘‘Look! Because the Shechina of my God is not within me
did these evils happen to me.’’
31:18: And I will surely remove My Shechina from them on that day
because of all the wickedness that they did,
31:19: And now write for yourselves this praise
and teach it to Bnei Yisroel to place it in their mouths;
in order that this praise will be before Me a witness against Bnei Yisroel.
31:20: For I will bring them to the land that I swore to their forefathers, flowing milk and honey,
and they will eat, and be full, and wax fat;
and they will turn to idols of the nations and serve them
and they will infuriate before Me and break My covenant.
31:21: Should many evils and troubles happen to them,
this praise shall return and serve before them as witness —
for it shall never be forgotten from the lips of their progeny —
for it is revealed before Me their impulse that they are gratifying today
to the land that I swore.
31:22: Moshe wrote this praise on that day,
and he taught it to Bnei Yisroel.
31:27: Look! even while I live with you today you have been rebellious before Adonoy,
31:28: Assemble to me all the judges of your tribes and your enforcers,
and I will declare before them these statements,
and invoke as witnesses against them
31:29: For I know after my death, that you will become depraved
and you will veer from the way
and harm will happen to you at the end of time,
when you do what is wicked before Adonoy
to spite before Him with your actions.
31:30: Moshe spoke before all the assemblage of Yisroel
